response.justification: Bogdan is a deeply experienced staff-level generalist engineer (15+ years) with strong TypeScript/Node.js, AWS, distributed systems, testing culture, and demonstrated mentoring/teaching ability — all valuable for a forward-deployed role. However, the core requirement of 8+ years building production AI solutions is not met: GenAI exposure appears limited to roughly the last year at re:cinq (MCP code generators, agentic workflow tooling). The resume shows no evidence of RAG architectures, vector databases, LLM evaluation/observability pipelines, multi-agent frameworks (LangGraph/CrewAI), or Python, which are explicit requirements. Worth a screening call to probe the depth of the recent AI-infrastructure work, but on paper this is a partial fit at best for a Staff GenAI position.
strengths: 15+ years shipping production systems across web, backend, mobile, and embedded, with staff-level scope
Strong TypeScript/Node.js plus AWS CDK, Kubernetes, Docker, and microservices at high scale
Proven mentoring, workshop delivery, and consulting/customer-facing experience (Altom, courses, talks)
concerns: AI/GenAI experience appears to be ~1 year, far short of the 8+ years required
No evidence of RAG, vector databases, LLM evaluation/observability, or multi-agent frameworks
Python not listed among skills despite being a primary language for the role

key_factors.factor: Senior engineering breadth and cloud/TypeScript delivery
Missing RAG/vector DB/agent-framework and Python skills
